```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: string
      github_token:
        description: 'GitHub Token'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate-inputs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Validate PR number
        run: |
          if ! [[ ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid PR number"
            exit 1
          fi

  authenticate-octavia-bot:
    needs: validate-inputs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Set up Octavia Bot GitHub App credentials
        id: octavia-bot-auth
        uses: tibdex/github-app-token@v1
        with:
          app_id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private_key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

  fetch-changed-files:
    needs: authenticate-octavia-bot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get changed files
        id: get-changed-files
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          CHANGED_FILES=$(curl -H "Authorization: token ${{ steps.octavia-bot-auth.outputs.token }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files | jq -r '.[].filename')
          echo "::set-output name=changed_files::$CHANGED_FILES"

  check-connector-files:
    needs: fetch-changed-files
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for connector files
        id: check-connector-files
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=${{ steps.get-changed-files.outputs.changed_files }}
          CONNECTOR_PATH_PATTERN='^airbyte-integrations/connectors/[^/]+/$'
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -qE "$CONNECTOR_PATH_PATTERN"; then
            echo "Connector files found"
            echo "::set-output name=connector_changes::true"
          else
            echo "No connector files found"
            echo "::set-output name=connector_changes::false"
          fi

  post-status-comment:
    needs: check-connector-files
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Post status comment
        id: post-status-comment
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          STATUS_COMMENT=""
          if [[ ${{ needs.check-connector-files.outputs.connector_changes }} == "true" ]]; then
            STATUS_COMMENT="Documentation recommendations requested. Please wait while we process your PR."
          elif [[ ${{ needs.check-connector-files.outputs.connector_changes }} == "false" ]]; then
            STATUS_COMMENT="No connector changes detected. Documentation recommendations not applicable."
          else
            STATUS_COMMENT="Error processing PR. Please try again later."
          fi
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ github.event.inputs.github_token }}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"body\": \"$STATUS_COMMENT\"}" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments

  trigger-devin-action:
    needs: post-status-comment
    if: needs.check-connector-files.outputs.connector_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Devin action
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          echo "!connectordocs_pr_review $PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```
